summary: Members set a date to hear what happened when operators used an alternative count.
realLife: In its 2023 amendment to Maine LD 1909, the committee directed DEP to report its findings or recommendations on the temporary waiver process to the environment committee by February 2025. In February 2025 DEP told the committee it had received no waiver applications. The agency anticipated an application before sunset but had no completed trial to evaluate at that point.
